## Background

We ran 3 AlphaFold2 predictions,

- HIV-PR_monomer
- HIV-PR_Dimer
-My find-a-gene protein sequence

Here we analyze the resulting models and make some diagnostic plots that inform on model realibility

## 1. HIV-PR Monomer


###Read the 5 AF model


```{r, input}
pdb_files <- list.files(path = "HIV_monomer_94b5b",
           full.names = T,
           pattern= ".pdb")
```

```{r, pdbs}
library(bio3d)

pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit = TRUE, exefile="msa")
pdbs
```

Calculate the RMSD of all the models to each other (i.e. pairwise RMSD)

```{r, rmsd}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs,fit=T)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```
```{r}
# Read a reference PDB structure
pdb <- read.pdb("1hsg")
```

```{r}
core <- core.find(pdbs)
```
```{r}
core.inds <- print(core, vol=0.5)
```

```{r}
xyz <- pdbfit(pdbs, core.inds, outpath="corefit_structures")
```

## Predicted Alignment Error for domains

```{r}
library(jsonlite)

# Listing of all PAE JSON files
pae_files <- list.files(path="HIV_monomer_94b5b",
                        pattern=".*model.*\\.json",
                        full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pae1 <- read_json(pae_files[1],simplifyVector = TRUE)
pae5 <- read_json(pae_files[5],simplifyVector = TRUE)

attributes(pae1)
```

```{r}
# Per-residue pLDDT scores 
#  same as B-factor of PDB..
head(pae1$plddt) 
```

```{r}
pae1$max_pae

pae5$max_pae
```

```{r}
plot.dmat(pae1$pae, 
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)")
```

```{r}
plot.dmat(pae1$pae, 
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col = "black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```

# RMSF
Calculate RMSF - how far apart each amino acid is across all 5 Alphafold models


```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)
plot.bio3d(rf)
```
###Residue conservation

Read the AF MSA
d
```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path="HIV_monomer_94b5b",
                       pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
#ln_file
aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)
```
We can score residue conservation in the alignment with the `conserv()` function
```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)
```

Plot this conservation result

```{r}
plot(sim, type= "h")
```

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.9)
con$seq
```

For a final visualization of these functionally important sites we can map this conservation score to the Occupancy column of a PDB file for viewing in molecular viewer programs such as Mol*, PyMol, VMD, chimera etc.


```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])
occ <- vec2resno(sim[1:99], m1.pdb$atom$resno)
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="m1_conserv.pdb")
```


### AF scores (pLDTT & PAE score plots)

The plDDT scores are stored in the PDB models "B-factor" col and in a seperate JSON format file in the results directory. We can use either:
```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")
abline(v=100, col="gray")
```

## 2. HIV-PR Dimer

```{r}
pdb_files2 <- list.files(path = "HIV_dimer_23119",
           full.names = T,
           pattern= ".pdb")
pdbs2 <- pdbaln(pdb_files2, fit = TRUE, exefile="msa")
```
### RMSD

```{r}
rd2 <- rmsd(pdbs2,fit=T)
```
```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd2) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd2) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd2)
```

### RMSF

```{r}
rf2 <- rmsf(pdbs2$xyz)
plot.bio3d(rf2)
```

### Residue Conservation

```{r}
aln_file2 <- list.files(path="HIV_dimer_23119",
                       pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
aln2 <- read.fasta(aln_file2[1], to.upper = TRUE)
```
```{r}
sim2 <- conserv(aln2)
```

```{r}
plot(sim2, type= "h")
```

```{r}
con2 <- consensus(aln2, cutoff = 0.9)
con2$seq
```

```{r}
m2.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files2[1])
#Dimer so two diff chains
occ <- c(vec2resno(sim2[1:99], m2.pdb$atom$resno[m2.pdb$atom$chain == "A"]),
         vec2resno(sim2[1:99], m2.pdb$atom$resno[m2.pdb$atom$chain == "B"]))
write.pdb(m2.pdb, o=occ, file="m2_conserv.pdb")
```


### AF pLDDT & PAE score plot

```{r}
plotb3(pdbs2$b[1,], typ="l", lwd=2)
points(pdbs2$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs2$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs2$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs2$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")
abline(v=100, col="gray")
```
